name: Chemtrails (chemtrail conspiracy theory)
description: A conspiracy theory, originating in the late 1990s, claiming that the long-lasting condensation trails (contrails) left by aircraft are in fact 'chemtrails' — chemical or biological agents being deliberately sprayed by governments or other actors for purposes such as population control, weather modification, or covert geoengineering. Atmospheric scientists, public-health agencies, and aviation regulators across many countries have rejected the theory as unsupported.
origin: The chemtrail claim is a global Anglophone internet conspiracy theory with strongholds in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and parts of continental Europe.
